role.title: What will you be working on most?
role.aria: radiogroup of role=radio buttons, aria-checked, data-choice=<id>
role.forward: none selected -> Skip (tertiary); selected -> Continue if role is last step else Next

attribution.title: How did you first hear about Grok Bot?
attribution.order: Fisher-Yates shuffled once per onboarding run (c_e)
attribution.forward: finishesWalk=true always: none selected -> Skip (tertiary); selected -> Continue
attribution.report: reportOnboardingAttribution({source, sourcePosition(1-based in shuffled order)}) once, at hand-off

connect.title: Connect your apps
connect.forward: any listed connector connected -> Continue; else Skip for now (tertiary); both -> hand-off

hand_off: yt(): report attribution once -> enterHandOff -> start({creatorContext, role, roleUseCaseBots}) -> provision primary bot (createAgentFromTemplate default name/shape/color, isAutomatic, creatorContext) -> markOnboardingSeen -> kickstart primary -> create roleUseCaseBots sequentially (each kickstart)

creatorContext.role: The user primarily works in {label} — tailor suggestions and work to that area.
creatorContext.tools: The user works with {label} every day — start with those tools when suggesting connectors or taking on work.
creatorContext.join: space; role label = englishLabel; tools always [] in 0.79.3

roleUseCaseBots: Me(roleId,2): first 2 templates of that role in je order -> {name, description: templateDesc + " " + creatorContext, isKickstartRequested:true, isAutomatic:true, templateId}
